items.item:
4. Correcting an archived project with a stale revision is refused as stale,
   not as archived.
   Shows A04-1, A04-2. [witness: verification:registry_a04_stale_before_archived_refusal]
statements: answer(a) = first failing check of a in the order (1)..(6), else its effect   -- A04-1

for action a on record r in {Project, Customer} that may move r.revision:
  a.stated_revision != r.revision => refused, r unchanged   -- A04-2
